home.heroTitle: Hi, I'm Enzo Tasca. <highlight>I build web and hardware projects</highlight>, then I write about them.
home.heroDescription: This site is my public workshop: professional profile, technical articles, electronics and IT projects, YouTube channel content, and notes on how I work.
home.figureCaption: Web apps, circuits, tutorials: one single workshop.
home.profileTitle: A technical profile, told through real projects.
home.profileDescription: I work in web development and use this site as a hub to collect skills, experiments, articles, and videos. The goal isn't just to show what I can do, but to explain how I get there.
home.skillsTitle: What I bring to a project.
home.projectsDescription: A collection of projects that blend web development, electronics, and technical storytelling. Each project can become an article, a video, or a case study.
home.articlesTitle: Articles that explain the thinking behind the projects.
home.youtubeTitle: Hands-on videos to follow a project as it takes shape.
home.youtubeDescription: The channel is where I show the behind-the-scenes: schematics, code, debugging, mistakes, and iterations. The site ties it all together and links it to the articles.
home.youtubeNextTitle: ESP32 + web dashboard: from sensor to UI
home.newsletterTitle: Get articles, videos, and lab notes delivered.
home.newsletterDescription: A no-fluff newsletter: project updates on web dev, hands-on electronics, new YouTube releases, and technical notes that don't make it into videos.
home.newsletterHelp: No spam. Just technical content, updates, and new videos.
home.newsletterConsentLabel: I consent to receiving the newsletter and to the processing of my data for sending content.

projects.title: Projects
projects.heading: Web projects, hardware, and technical content.
projects.description: An organized collection of the projects I build and document: software, digital electronics, prototypes, and hands-on walkthroughs.

articles.asideDescription: Here you'll be able to add a table of contents, a link to the related YouTube video, repository, or project materials.
